grammar_title: 非限制性定语从句(Non-restrictive relative clauses)
source: 人教版2019选择性必修一 Unit 1 Discover useful structures:非限制性定语从句(逗号隔开,补充信息)。铁律:非限制性里 that 永远错;指人 who/whom,指物/整句 which;whose/where/when 各司其职;介词+which/whom。句子地道、答案唯一。

points.point: who/whom(指人)、which(指物)引导非限制性定语从句
points.overview: 逗号隔开的非限制性定语从句中,先行词指人作主语用 who、作宾语用 whom,先行词指物用 which;关系代词 that 不能用于非限制性定语从句(常作干扰项)。

points.point: whose / where / when 引导非限制性定语从句
points.overview: whose 表所属(指人或物),where 跟在地点先行词后作地点状语,when 跟在时间先行词后作时间状语;都用逗号隔开补充信息。

points.point: 介词+which/whom · which 指代整个主句
points.overview: some of which / all of whom / most of whom / in which case 等‘量词/介词 + which/whom’结构;以及 which 指代前面整个主句(…, which surprised us all)。

questions.stem: Tu Youyou, ____ discovered artemisinin, won the Nobel Prize.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 Tu Youyou 指人作主语 → who(that 不能用于非限制性)。

questions.stem: The book, ____ was published in 2015, tells Einstein's life story.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 book 指物作主语 → which。

questions.stem: Einstein, ____ was Jewish, had to flee Germany in 1933.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 Einstein 指人作主语 → who。

questions.stem: Artemisinin, ____ saved many lives, is now a standard treatment.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 artemisinin 指物作主语 → which。

questions.stem: Zhong Nanshan, ____ we all admire, managed the SARS outbreak.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 Zhong Nanshan 指人作 admire 的宾语 → whom。

questions.stem: Florence Nightingale, ____ founded modern nursing, is still respected today.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词指人作主语 → who。

questions.stem: The medicine, ____ was called artemisinin, soon cured many patients.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 medicine 指物作主语 → which。

questions.stem: Wu Mengchao, ____ performed operations into his 90s, was a great doctor.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词指人作主语 → who。

questions.stem: The Nobel Prize, ____ she received in 2015, is a great honour.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 prize 指物作 received 的宾语 → which。

questions.stem: Alexander Fleming, ____ discovered penicillin, changed medicine forever.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词指人作主语 → who。

questions.stem: Her team examined 2,000 old texts, ____ took them many years.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、指前述事情(examining texts)→ which。

questions.stem: Lu Xun, ____ many people regard as a great writer, was born in 1881.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词指人作 regard 的宾语 → whom。

questions.stem: The patients, most of them recovered, were grateful to her, ____ pleased the whole team.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、which 指代前面的整件事 → which。

questions.stem: Cao Xueqin, ____ wrote The Dream of the Red Mansions, suffered great poverty.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词指人作主语 → who。

questions.stem: The general theory of relativity, ____ Einstein created, is famous worldwide.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 theory 指物作 created 的宾语 → which。

questions.stem: Helen Keller, ____ teacher opened a new world to her, wrote her autobiography at 22.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、表所属(Keller 的老师)→ whose。

questions.stem: Mei Lanfang, ____ took Beijing Opera to the USA, became known worldwide.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词指人作主语 → who。

questions.stem: The four papers, ____ he published in 1905, made him world-famous.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 papers 指物作 published 的宾语 → which。

questions.stem: Tu's colleagues, ____ she worked with for years, shared in the honour.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词指人作 worked with 的宾语 → whom。

questions.stem: Sweet wormwood, ____ grows in many places, holds an important secret.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词指物作主语 → which。

questions.stem: Tu Youyou went to Hainan, ____ malaria was more common, to study patients.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 Hainan 是地点、从句完整 → where。

questions.stem: Einstein moved to Princeton, ____ he worked as a researcher for years.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 Princeton 是地点 → where。

questions.stem: It happened in 1933, ____ Hitler came to power in Germany.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 1933 是时间、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: Einstein, ____ hair often stood on end, looked a little odd to the public.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、表所属(爱因斯坦的头发)→ whose。

questions.stem: She returned to Beijing in 1969, ____ she became the head of the project.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 1969 是时间 → when。

questions.stem: The team worked in Beijing, ____ they finally succeeded in 1971.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 Beijing 是地点 → where。

questions.stem: Tu Youyou, ____ research led to artemisinin, was born in Ningbo.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、表所属(她的研究)→ whose。

questions.stem: Einstein studied in Switzerland, ____ he entered university in 1896.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 Switzerland 是地点 → where。

questions.stem: He won the prize in 1922, ____ his explanation of the photoelectric effect was honoured.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 1922 是时间 → when。

questions.stem: Lu Xun went to Japan, ____ he first studied medicine.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 Japan 是地点 → where。

questions.stem: Mei Lanfang, ____ skill was admired worldwide, helped spread Beijing Opera.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、表所属(梅兰芳的技艺)→ whose。

questions.stem: She graduated in 1955, ____ she began to work at a medical academy.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 1955 是时间 → when。

questions.stem: Einstein took a job at the patent office, ____ he kept studying physics.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 office 是地点 → where。

questions.stem: Helen Keller, ____ early life was dark and silent, learned to communicate.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、表所属(凯勒的早年生活)→ whose。

questions.stem: The story is set in Shaoxing, ____ Lu Xun was born in 1881.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 Shaoxing 是地点 → where。

questions.stem: He passed away in 1955, ____ the whole world mourned his loss.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 1955 是时间 → when。

questions.stem: Steve Jobs, ____ products changed the world, was driven to succeed.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、表所属(乔布斯的产品)→ whose。

questions.stem: She moved her work to a lab in Beijing, ____ the final tests were carried out.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 lab 是地点 → where。

questions.stem: It all began in 1967, ____ the government formed a team of scientists.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 1967 是时间 → when。

questions.stem: Sun Yat-sen, ____ ideas brought people together, is called the founder of modern China.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、表所属(孙中山的思想)→ whose。

questions.stem: She examined 280,000 plants, some of ____ showed promise against malaria.
questions.explanation: ‘some of + which’指物的非限制性 → which(介词/量词后不用 that)。

questions.stem: The medicine was tested on patients, most of ____ recovered quickly.
questions.explanation: 先行词 patients 指人、‘most of + whom’ → whom。

questions.stem: Einstein published four papers, all of ____ became famous in science.
questions.explanation: 先行词 papers 指物、‘all of + which’ → which。

questions.stem: She failed more than 190 times, ____ would have stopped most people.
questions.explanation: which 指代前面整个主句(失败190多次这件事)→ which。

questions.stem: He met many scientists, several of ____ later won the Nobel Prize.
questions.explanation: 先行词 scientists 指人、‘several of + whom’ → whom。

questions.stem: The team tested 380 treatments, none of ____ fully cured the disease at first.
questions.explanation: 先行词 treatments 指物、‘none of + which’ → which。

questions.stem: Tu Youyou shared the honour with her team, ____ moved the whole country.
questions.explanation: which 指代前面整个主句(她与团队分享荣誉)→ which。

questions.stem: He had many friends, both of ____ remembered his kindness for years.
questions.explanation: 先行词 friends 指人、‘both of + whom’ → whom。

questions.stem: She read hundreds of texts, in ____ she finally found the key sentence.
questions.explanation: ‘介词 in + which’指物 → which(介词后不用 that)。

questions.stem: Einstein forgot his friends' birthdays, ____ amused everyone around him.
questions.explanation: which 指代前面整个主句(他忘记生日这件事)→ which。

questions.stem: The project had several stages, the last of ____ proved the hardest.
questions.explanation: 先行词 stages 指物、‘the last of + which’ → which。

questions.stem: She thanked the researchers, many of ____ had worked with her for years.
questions.explanation: 先行词 researchers 指人、‘many of + whom’ → whom。

questions.stem: He was awarded the Nobel Prize, ____ is one of the highest honours of all.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、先行词 Nobel Prize 指物作主语 → which(此处也可视为单一先行词)。

questions.stem: She tried two methods, neither of ____ worked at the start.
questions.explanation: 先行词 methods 指物、‘neither of + which’ → which。

questions.stem: He gave talks to many students, some of ____ became scientists themselves.
questions.explanation: 先行词 students 指人、‘some of + whom’ → whom。

questions.stem: The medicine finally worked, ____ proved the value of traditional medicine.
questions.explanation: which 指代前面整个主句(药终于有效这件事)→ which。

questions.stem: He wrote four papers, the most famous of ____ explained relativity.
questions.explanation: 先行词 papers 指物、‘the most famous of + which’ → which。

questions.stem: She trained young doctors, all of ____ admired her greatly.
questions.explanation: 先行词 doctors 指人、‘all of + whom’ → whom。

questions.stem: He had to flee his country, ____ saddened him deeply for the rest of his life.
questions.explanation: which 指代前面整个主句(他被迫逃离这件事)→ which。

questions.stem: Tu's team studied 2,000 texts, from ____ they drew the crucial idea.
questions.explanation: ‘介词 from + which’指物 → which(介词后不用 that)。
